note: Alberta Parks recreation area campground in southern Kananaskis, 13 km west of the Cowboy Trail (Hwy 22) on Hwy 532, bordered by Johnson and Willow creeks. The Lower Loop has the cookhouse and playground, sites along the creek and equestrian sites with corrals; the Upper Loop is in the forest, with an access trail to the OHV trails south of Hwy 532 (no OHV use in the campground). No day use; generators 9 a.m. - 9 p.m. --Claude
